description:
[BUG] A value-template (type-variable-bearing) activation reached the backend as a lowered executable and panicked: "value-template ... cannot be materialized". Repro: fn main do dbg(Enum.with_index(["a","b"], fn (x,_index) -> x <> "!" end)) end.

RESOLVED by cross-activation surface grounding (NOT by the value_types/27.8 theory, NOT by a ground-sibling prune — both disproven during investigation; see history below).

ROOT CAUSE
A boxed callable that flows through a GENERIC activation contributes a value-template call surface (e.g. the reduce closure analyzed at element=α). The local callable flow has no ground evidence — the generic activation never sees a concrete element — so the surface stays value-template and `callable_flow_resolutions` minted a value-template resolution. That dead generic activation got lowered: its body materialized the bare parameter (`x <> "!"`) and the native invariant panicked. The same absent-value shape also produced harmless artifacts elsewhere (zero-width continuations, omitted tuple builds, Halt-specialized resumes).

THE FIX
`World::ground_surface_for_template` searches the whole root's activation map for the function's representable GROUND SIBLING surface — the same activation with its unrepresentable positions grounded — and `callable_flow_resolutions` substitutes it (SUBSTITUTION, not pruning, so transport stays consistent: the capture shape references the ground resolution). Only the SURFACE is grounded; CAPTURES are threaded through unchanged because a captured callable carries its closure identity, which refines across activations and must not be matched. The boxed callable now resolves to its real runtime instance; the dead generic activation is never demanded, so its callsite (the panicking mapper) is never walked. A genuine polymorphic escape (no ground sibling) keeps its template and is lowered boxed.
- world.rs: ground_surface_for_template + is_ground_instance_of_template (representable sibling; value-template positions grounded, all others IDENTICAL).
- semantic.rs: ActivationMap::keys.
- runtime_demand.rs: the substitution in callable_flow_resolutions.

WHY THE EARLIER THEORIES WERE WRONG (kept so no one re-treads)
- value_types frame divergence (27.8 retarget): the gate reads addressed ActivationKey.inputs, never value_types; removing the alpha_normalize changed nothing.
- ground-sibling PRUNE (path B): a value-template resolution is also a legitimate boxed-callable transport member (e.g. 65[α7]), and it ALSO has a ground sibling — so "value-template + ground sibling" is not a discriminator. Pruning dangled transport (executable_membership = closure.executables; every resolution must be a member). Grounding (substitution) is the correct operation; the prune was not.

VERIFICATION
- compiler2_interp_runs_enum_with_index_mapper_from_backend_artifacts re-enabled; asserts ["a!","b!"]. The is_value_template tombstone is deleted.
- Full lib 2241/0 (zero warnings); fixture_matrix 337/0 end-to-end.

TEST FALLOUT (handled)
The fix grounds away ALL redundant generics uniformly (matrix-green-safe), removing absent-value artifacts that 3 structural guards were pinned to. Resolution per the "better test OR prove-impossible-and-drop" rule, decided by a whole-matrix scan:
- zero-width resume payload guard: RE-POINTED to `Enum.each([1,2,3], fn(x)->x end)` — a LEGITIMATE zero-width payload (ignored call result → Nothing by demand), which survives grounding.
- omitted-absent-tuple-build guard: DROPPED (0/337) — requires a transport-absent tuple field, which grounding eliminates.
- Halt-specialized-DeliveredResume guard: DROPPED (0/337) — requires an absent delivered value, which grounding eliminates.
Their stronger invariant (no value-template activation reaches lowering) is now guarded by the re-enabled with_index repro.

comments.text: Root cause refined (fz-hwn.27.5 probe): the key IS addressed; the phantom survives because value_types use the OLD alpha_normalize_vars frame (α0) while the key uses addressing (a0), so phantom_resolution_keys can't match it to a ground sibling to prune. Cure = value_types addressed in activation scope (retargeted onto fz-hwn.27.8). Predicate to flag it = fz-hwn.27.5.

title: Phantom polymorphic activation reaches the backend (FunctionId[a0,a0] not runtime-materializable)
